## Why

PHYS02B normalizes a BED sharing shape to a BEQ total. This follow-up tests the response to a source-defined full-BED model in which the total and differential rates share the same H/He oscillator, while holding the source, bath, CCC27 effective excitation costs, Coulomb closure and causal transport fixed.

## Changes and evidence

- Add the analytic nonrelativistic H oscillator and the original printed He coefficients, the frozen derivation/contract, implementation and source provenance.
- Record actual 2400/4800-node transports, exit 0 and 15 scoped checks. Independent final decision: `PROMOTE_SCOPED` (review SHA256 `f1b736d543ff94dd5dc027e337e57a90ef46c189e240eebfb0161ab5ca4bec27`).
- At 4800 nodes, cumulative H I ionization changes +5.19218%, He I +0.516080%, and heat power +0.0258541% relative to matching saved legacy results. These are conditional joint-model differences; paired two-grid diagnostics are not certified physical error bounds.
- Add a self-contained NCP handoff, exact input/reference identities, archive verifier/extractor and return collector. The next node is a bounded matched 9600-node comparison, at most two sequential transports and 3600 s. Actual NCP execution remains `PREPARED_NOT_EXECUTED`.
- Independent review found and separately verified a fix for resource overadmission when a parent cgroup is more restrictive than the leaf. Actual NCP resource admission remains mandatory.

## Scope and delivery

Stacked on `research/cr-phys02b-causal-cascade-20261010` at `b5b0f2244311a6e46692da55e75db6d04d3ef305`. Only the new `research/cr_phys02c_20261011` unit is added. This draft does not admit production or close the inherited source/atomic gates.

`PHYS02_DELAY OPEN`; `production_history HOLD`; `atomic_G02 UNRESOLVED`; `b_grid NO_GO`; `all_bound OPEN`; `R17B2B NO_CERTIFIED_SOURCE_SHARPENING`.

The immutable handoff ZIP and exact Drive/Dropbox locators will be recorded in a subsequent receipt-only commit after actual upload. The ZIP contains the full recovered parent dependencies, both verified Astra v4.0.0 harness archives, the NCP prompt/code/inputs and all evidence needed for the prepared task. No additional user attachment is required.
